title: November — 4-day split
description: Four days, each on different muscles: A Chest & Triceps, B Legs, C Back & Biceps, D Shoulders & Hinge. Rotate A → B → C → D (Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri works well). Free weights lead; cables, leg press and Smith fill in.
whatsNew: New 4-day split: Chest & Triceps, Legs, Back & Biceps, Shoulders & Hinge.
Warm up 5 min on the rower, SkiErg or air bike before every session.
The target changes each week: leave 3 reps in the tank, then 2, then 1. The app shows it on every exercise.
Week 4 (22–28 Nov) is a deload. The app drops a set and suggests about 10% lighter weights.

weekPlan.focus: Find working weights on the new lifts and log everything.
Add weight wherever every set hit the top of the range.
Deload: one set fewer, about 10% lighter, clean technique.
Back to normal. Carry the numbers into December.
